privacy.rule: no frame containing an identifiable customer may leave the in-market store network, be used as training or conditioning input, or be stored outside the in-market environment
privacy.gate_note: A privacy classification is a GATE, not a weighting. Eliminate on it before any latency or cost argument is made.

features.overhead_note: descriptor-only classroom payload excludes keypoint metadata, headers, timestamps and transport overhead

generation.note: S times F is a fixed per-frame-step classroom heuristic, not universal video-model compute scaling; assumed time is illustrative.

model.note: Parameter memory scales by b/32 when weights move from 32-bit to b-bit. A low-rank adapter of rank r on a d x m layer trains r(d+m) parameters instead of d*m.

energy.note: ILLUSTRATIVE. Energy per sample is approximated as overhead x joules-per-FLOP x FLOPs-per-sample. A real carbon figure additionally requires hardware inventory, total kWh, measured utilisation and grid carbon intensity.

cost_note: ILLUSTRATIVE rate assumed for the selected transfer direction, not a verified cloud-egress price.
